title: Remove AI assistance/guidance tools and remove Work With Us button from Community page

requirements.text: Remove the global AI chat tutor feature from the app UI so it is no longer rendered or accessible anywhere (including removing the floating chat button/widget).

quotes: remove ai assistance and ai guidance tool.

acceptanceCriteria: No AI chat floating button/widget appears for any user state (authenticated or not).
The app builds successfully with no unused-import/type errors after removing the AI chat tutor UI wiring.
No routes/pages render AI chat tutor UI components.

requirements.text: Remove the AI assistance / AI guidance tooling UI components from the learning/tutorial experience (including any panels that show AI feedback/guidance and any UI controls that enable/disable AI assistance).

quotes: remove ai assistance and ai guidance tool.

acceptanceCriteria: No pages or dialogs show AI guidance/feedback panels or AI enable/disable controls.
Any user-facing copy that explicitly advertises AI guidance on the Learning area is updated to non-AI wording (English).
The app builds successfully with no references to removed AI guidance components.

requirements.text: Remove the "Work with us" button from the Community page and ensure the related dialog cannot be opened from that page.

quotes: remove work with us button  in community page

acceptanceCriteria: The Community page no longer displays a "Work with us" button.
The Community page no longer imports or renders the WorkWithUsDialog, and there is no state/action to open it from Community.
Community page functionality for listing posts and sharing recordings continues to work as before.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add a migration file if state schema changes are required.
nonGoals: Do not add new AI features or replacement assistants.
Do not redesign the Community or Learning pages beyond removing the specified AI and Work With Us UI elements.
Do not change Stripe checkout behavior.
